verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is API-first, which suits headless automation. It offers a JSON REST API and SDKs in many languages that sign requests automatically using ECDSA key-based credentials, so no interactive login is needed. A self-serve Sandbox and environment switching by changing only the base URL and credentials support automated testing pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI or headless automation guidance, a first-party CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Our API is RESTFul. This means we use predictable, resource-oriented URLs to do banking operations.
Our SDKs automatically handle request signing.
Feel free to test our services in Sandbox by creating your workspace here (no need to contact us)
Switching to Production requires you to change the base url and the credentials only. The SDKs select the base url according to the environment you choose.
